fusions.name: Famine's Ride
fusions.desc: Rides a devouring cloud through a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Cropping Bite
fusions.desc: Sends a nibbling bolt of swarm at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Swarm
fusions.desc: Kicks a swarm up out of the grass that lasts 10 seconds and bites an enemy within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Next Field Over
fusions.desc: Each kill builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once and you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, the stacks fade.
